chapter_mission: Jacen agrees, face-to-face with Lumiya, to travel to the Vectivus asteroid with her. Brooks Second Plot Point.
chapter_turn: The corruption arc crosses from consideration to commitment — Jacen walks onto Lumiya's ship voluntarily, with Ben in tow.

scene_plan.purpose: Final meeting on Coruscant; Jacen agrees; Ben comes along; departure.

exit_vector: The ship breaking orbit with Jacen, Ben, and Lumiya aboard; Nelani Dinn watching the departure from a distant comm-channel.
notes: Second Plot Point. The book's final information is acquired — the specific setting of the corruption will be Vectivus's asteroid.
